name: Indelible
description: A self-hosted, permanent home for everything you save to read later

paths.name: Data
paths.description: The database (your library, highlights, notes and search index), every archived page, PDF and EPUB in silo/, secret keys and settings.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Indelible web app and API, published on host as 6152

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: PUBLIC_URL
variables.description: The exact address you open Indelible at, like http://192.168.1.20:6152. Change localhost to your server IP. Sign-in only works at this address. Use your own https:// domain if you put Indelible behind a reverse proxy.
